summary: First Bancorp filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, announcing a routine quarterly cash dividend rather than a special situation. The board declared $0.24 per common share, payable October 23, 2026 to holders of record September 30, 2026. CEO Richard Moore cited solid second-quarter performance, stable credit quality, and strong capital. The company is a $13.0 billion-asset bank holding company operating 113 First Bank branches in the Carolinas. No advisors, no premium, no structural mechanics. Watch for ordinary dividend sustainability and payout trends, not event-driven arbitrage.
